short_description: Berlin-headquartered German climate-technology company (founded 2017 by Mario Kohle, Jochen Ziervogel and Viktor Wingert) that offers residential solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, heat pumps and electric-vehicle wallboxes to homeowners in Germany on a monthly-subscription (rent-to-own) model; became Germany's first widely reported climate unicorn in October 2021 after a €150M Series C led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2.
